method: Classical positive-region reduct + LEM2; second-layer K=4 partial matching
denominator: Test strict coverage = >=1 exact matched rule divided by all held-out Test cases
K4_notice: K=4 is an author-defined top-four partially matched rules fallback with <=1 mismatching antecedent, NOT a verified literature K4 algorithm.
abstention_notice: Current system predicts train-majority on unmatched cases and has no formal reject policy. The pilot evaluates operational acceptance if no-match were rejected, rather than an existing reject_rate.
leakage: No test labels used to fit model, rules, or K4 ranking. Ground truth used only in outcome evaluation.
no_equivalence: Assisted coverage is NOT strict rule coverage. Do not compare them as same metric.
data_source: Original pinned UCI 12/19/44; not newly acquired external datasets.
